PostgreSQL_0:
SELECT account_id
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT trans_id) >= 2
   AND (MAX(amount) - MIN(amount)) > 12000;
PostgreSQL_4:
WITH UpdatedTransactions AS (
    UPDATE transactions_1k
    SET amount = amount * 1.10
    WHERE merchant = 'Gas Station'
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT 
    ut.transactionid,
    c.segment
FROM UpdatedTransactions ut
JOIN customers c ON ut.custid = c.custid;
PostgreSQL_5:
SELECT
  referrer.id AS referrer_id,
  COUNT(referred.id) AS number_of_premium_referrals
FROM
  users AS referrer
JOIN
  users AS referred ON referrer.referral_id = referred.id
WHERE
  referred.premium_account_activated = TRUE
GROUP BY
  referrer.id
ORDER BY
  referrer.id;
PostgreSQL_8:
SELECT
  e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.event_id
JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
WHERE
  a.amount <> b.amount;
